description: DEAL v1.2 promotion gate (ISSUE-0107): intentionally unsupported v1.2 cases for the JVM backend-runtime gate. Every case names its tracked follow-up issue in 'knownFail'; when the tracked issue lands and the case passes, the runner fails with a promotion instruction. ISSUE-0106 promoted jvm-unicode-scalar-string-length. ISSUE-0378 re-pinned jvm-int32-literal-out-of-range and jvm-int32-add-overflow back to tracked known-fails: the LegacyProfileRegressionCatalog routes both cases LEGACY_REGRESSION + LEGACY_SAFE_INT under the untouched legacy harness, where the ±(2^53−1) long carriers keep 2147483648 in range (the expected E8004 never fires) and the legacy parse contract admits the out-of-range literal (the expected E1036 never fires) — the two cases keep failing and stay tracked with no stale gate. Dropping these markers is the later sanctioned promotion owned by jvm-v12-int32-bytes D6 (ISSUE-0381); the restored backend-runtime int-add-overflow known-fail fixture and the two-backend slice re-home (jvm-int32-slice.json#int32-add-overflow) carry the activated-route E8004 coverage.

tests.name: jvm-int32-literal-out-of-range
tests.description: v1.2 signed 32-bit int: the literal 2147483648 outside the unary-minus position is a compile-time error (E1036)

tests.name: jvm-int32-add-overflow
tests.description: v1.2 signed 32-bit int: 2147483647 + 1 raises E8004 at runtime

tests.name: jvm-bytes-buffer-ops
tests.description: v1.2 bytes: bytes(4) allocates a zero-filled buffer; b[0] = 255; b.length is 4
